opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000 and will only exceptionally exceed £6,000; travel awards up to £2,000 (≤13 days) or £2,500 (≥14 days) per person; up to £5,000 for PhD fieldwork visits of six months or more.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects (though the UK office may consider individuals with proof of organisational support).
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that bring people together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas/expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language/cultural studies, and academic research, visits and exchange.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000; continuing projects may apply for up to three years at a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK; projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan, be supported by reputable referees not at the same institution as either partner, and provide evidence of facilities from host institutions/partners. Applicants should normally show an existing research record; practitioners, managers, carers and others in health-related fields are also considered.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses, conference and publication costs, and other project costs.
